items.title: Ed Allen Interview, 1961-01-14
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...the band saved by Connie Zinn. [INTERVIEWEE] That was a Connie Zinn band.

ctx.x: That's a good record. With whose band were you working at the time you made most of your recordings for Clarence Williams? Once I was working with Alain Rolf and Leroy Tiff, the band saved by Connie Zinn.
That was a Connie Zinn band. Yeah. Alain Rolf had a band first when he left, and Leroy Tiff took over. That was about three or two or three years later.
Where did Clarence Williams get the idea for the Washboard? That was his own idea, huh? I really think that was Jasper Taylor's idea, the drummer from Chicago.
